name: North Carolina Department of Health and Human Services
source_citation: NCDHHS Strategic Vision & Priority Roadmap 2025-2028 (NC OSBM)
mission: In collaboration with our partners, to protect the health and safety of all North Carolinians and provide essential human services.
funder_affinities: Department of Health and Human Services
Centers for Disease Control and Prevention
Substance Abuse and Mental Health Services Administration

goals.title: Behavioral Health Transformation & Opioid Overdose Prevention
goals.description: Expand community-based behavioral health crisis facilities, strengthen medication-assisted treatment for opioid use disorder, and implement school-based youth mental health programs.
objectives: Open 24/7 behavioral health urgent care centers in high-overdose counties
Distribute naloxone and fentanyl test strips through community harm reduction programs
Expand peer support specialist workforce and mobile crisis response teams
Deploy evidence-based youth resilience and suicide prevention curricula in public schools

goals.title: Maternal, Infant, and Early Childhood Health Equity
goals.description: Dramatically reduce maternal mortality and severe morbidity disparities, expand perinatal nurse home visiting, and promote universal early childhood developmental screenings.
objectives: Close maternal mortality gap for rural and minority mothers through specialized community doulas
Expand evidence-based home visiting programs (Nurse-Family Partnership) to all 100 counties
Implement postpartum telehealth monitoring for gestational hypertension and diabetes

goals.title: Rural Healthcare Infrastructure & Clinical Workforce Retention
goals.description: Stabilize rural critical access hospitals, expand loan repayment programs for rural primary care doctors and nurses, and modernize community health center clinical facilities.
objectives: Fund broadband-enabled telehealth kiosks in rural county health departments
Provide educational debt relief for bilingual clinicians practicing in designated shortage areas
Support federally qualified health centers (FQHC) capital facility expansions

goals.title: Public Health Preparedness, Epidemiology & Infectious Disease Surveillance
goals.description: Enhance state laboratory genomics, accelerate vector-borne disease tracking (mosquito and tick-borne pathogens), and fortify public health surge capacity.
objectives: Modernize North Carolina State Laboratory of Public Health genetic sequencing platforms
Expand statewide wastewater viral monitoring network across municipal treatment plants
Strengthen local health department communicable disease investigation teams

goals.title: Social Determinants of Health: Food Security & Housing Stabilization
goals.description: Integrate NCCARE360 statewide coordinated care network with federal anti-hunger and supportive housing programs to address root drivers of poor health.
objectives: Expand medically tailored meals and produce prescription programs for chronic illness patients
Support rapid re-housing and permanent supportive housing for medically vulnerable homeless adults
Integrate SNAP and WIC enrollment kiosks into community health hubs
